title: Avoid Lifestyle Inflation Trap

scenes.text: Why a $500 raise can cost you $5,000 later?
scenes.query: raise leads to lifestyle inflation cost

scenes.text: Studies show 70% of people increase spending within three months of a pay raise.
scenes.query: percentage people increase spending after raise

scenes.text: If you add $200 of extra expenses each month, you lose $4,800 a year that could have been saved.
Lock 20% of every raise into savings before you spend.
scenes.label: SAVE FIRST

scenes.text: Follow and your future rich self will thank you.

description: A pay raise can silently erode your wealth if you let spending creep in. Learn the simple 20% rule to protect gains. Follow for actionable money habits.
